## Description

Extends traditional Kalman filtering by incorporating fractional Brownian motion noise assumptions and fractional memory parameters ($d$) to track time-varying hedge ratios in persistent cointegrated pairs.

## Where it may fit

Pairs trading with slow mean-reversion persistence, structural cointegration drift environments.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Funds, Quantitative Equity Market-Neutral Desks.

## Required data

Historical price series of paired assets, high-frequency tick quotes.

## Caveats

Estimating fractional noise variance parameters accurately requires sufficient historical depth.
